title: introduce incident-knapsack: prioritized telemetry packer and on-call tile exporter
author: Aria Patel
release_notes: Adds 'incident-knapsack' packer and a CLI flag to export compact on-call tiles for faster handoffs; non-breaking, opt-in behind CLI subcommand.
description:
Summary:
Adds a new utility (incident-knapsack) and a CLI/console exporter to produce compact, prioritized incident artifacts that stitch together top telemetry slices, playbook snippets, and a small timeline suitable for rapid on-call handoff or postmortem starters. Motivation: during high-noise incidents engineers spent 5–10 minutes assembling the minimal context bullets (top traces, impacted services, top error messages, recent deploys). This adds an automated, reproducible pack so responders can jump straight to mitigation steps.

What this PR contains:
- A packer library (slo_toolkit.packager.incident_knapsack) that scores and selects telemetry slices by impact, SLO delta, and recency.
- A CLI command: `sloctl incident pack --out tile.json --limit 5 --score-policy priority-v2` that emits a compact tile consumable by the Console and incident-bot.
- Console exporter hook (console/tiles/exporter.py) that converts a pack into a small UI tile (title, short list of hints, top traces links).
- Small on-call playbook fragment generator that includes one-liners for safe rollback, cache flush, and graceful degrade (configurable via templates).
- Tests: unit tests for scoring heuristics, end-to-end smoke flow that runs packer against synthetic telemetry, and linted schema changes for tile format.

Design notes:
- Scoring: combines SLO-delta (weight 0.6), impacted-user-sessions (0.25), and first-seen-recentness (0.15). Policy is pluggable (priority-v2 is default) so teams can tune for latency-sensitive vs revenue-sensitive incidents.
- Size & performance: packs are limited by token budget and number of items (CLI defaults to 5 items). The packer performs a light sample+rank so runtime for a 24h window is under 350ms on a typical test machine.
- Privacy & filtering: PII/PII-like fields are sanitized via existing scrubber utility; customers can opt-out of auto-exports.

Commits (summary):
- feat(packager): initial incident-knapsack selection and scoring engine
- feat(cli): add `sloctl incident pack` command and flags
- feat(exporter): tile exporter and console mapping for compact tiles
- test: add unit tests for scoring and simple e2e harness
- ci: update pipeline to include tile schema linting

Files changed (high-level):
- src/slo_toolkit/packager/incident_knapsack.py (core selection + scoring)
- cli/sloctl/commands/incident_pack.py (new subcommand)
- console/tiles/exporter.py (tile generation hook)
- templates/oncall_fragments.yaml (playbook templates)
- tests/packager/test_scoring.py (unit tests)
- ci/pipeline/tile_schema_check.yml (CI check)

Testing & CI:
- Unit tests: pass locally and on CI (coverage maintained).
- Integration: added a lightweight e2e scenario that runs packer against a synthetic SLO timeline; flaky on first run due to timezones, fixed by normalizing timestamps.
- CI checks: lint (pass), unit (pass), e2e (pass after rerun), tile-schema (pass). Final status: all green.

Review conversation (high level):
- Lina Gomez: "Nice work on the prioritization. Can you add a small explanation for the weighting and make the policy JSON-schema discoverable from the CLI?"
  - Author reply (Aria): "Added policy schema file and `--dump-policy` flag; included usage in help text."
- Evan Park: "We should make sure this pack can't leak long traces in-officer channel; can you limit trace snippets to 3 lines and link to full trace via presigned URL?"
  - Author reply (Aria): "Implemented 3-line snippets and presigned link builder with TTL 15m; documented opt-out."
- Marcus Lee: "Minor: prefer consistent timestamp normalization and add example tile to docs."
  - Author reply (Aria): "Normalized to UTC and added example tile JSON to examples/."
- Final: approvals from Lina and Marcus; Evan requested a tiny tweak to the tile TTL which was applied.

Risk & rollout plan:
- Opt-in CLI only. No automatic changes to existing alerts or dashboards. Console tile export is behind a feature flag `compact_tiles.enable` (default false) to allow staged rollout to customers.
- If adopted, recommend gradual rollout: internal pilot → beta customers → global enable.

Backwards compatibility:
- Tile schema is additive; older consoles ignore unknown fields. There are no breaking API changes.

Merge details:
- Merge method: squash and merge
- Merged by: Marcus Lee
- Squash commit message: "incident(knapsack): add packer + CLI + tile exporter for compact on-call handoffs"

Follow-ups planned (linked Linear):
- ENG-2215: telemetry-weight tuning dashboard for teams
- ENG-2219: incident-bot integration to auto-post packaged tiles to private channels for on-call rotation

Notes for reviewers: please focus on the scoring unit tests and the privacy scrubber paths. The policy schema and examples are in templates/policies/priority-v2.yaml.

This PR is part of the broader on-call tooling initiative to reduce median time-to-action during noisy degradation windows.
